def state(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    def firstG(row):
        for j in range(64):
            if a[row][j]=='G': return j
        return None
    g=None
    for i in range(44,64):
        for j in range(64):
            if a[i][j]=='N': g=(i,j); break
        if g: break
    gc=sum(row.count('G') for row in a)
    return (firstG(10),firstG(30),firstG(50),g,gc)
print("BEFORE", state(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':1}])
print("AFTER (25,1)", state(current_frame))
